title: Antifungal paenibacillus strains, fusaricidin-type compounds, and their use
abstract: The present invention relates to novel isolated bacterial strains, members of the genus Paenibacillus, that are originally isolated from soil and exhibit antagonistic activity against a wide range of pathogens and are capable of producing antimicrobial metabolites. While strains Lu16774 and Lu17007 belong to a new subspecies named as Paenibacillus polymyxa sp. Plantarum, strain Lu17015 was found to belong to a new species proposed for Paenibacillus epiphyticus.  The present invention also relates to at least one of these novel bacterial strains, whole culture broth or cell-free extract or fraction thereof or at least one metabolite thereof, and/or each bacterial strain or whole culture broth, cell-free extract. , a mutant of at least one of the novel bacterial strains having all of the identified characteristics of the fraction, and/or a metabolite of a mutant thereof exhibiting antagonistic activity against plant pathogens. The present invention also relates to methods of controlling or inhibiting plant pathogens or preventing plant pathogen infection by applying such compositions. The present invention also relates to novel fusaricidin-type compounds that are metabolites produced by the strains of the present invention.
